history.change: TbD1 'absent' now requires the junction-spanning region (H37Rv 1,757,997-1,767,717) on a single contig (>=80%); otherwise the call is 'not_determined'. mod_tbd1.py records flank evidence; report.py explains the rule, shows the evidence row, and no longer compares against an 'expected' call when the lineage is unassigned or the call is not determined; check.py verifies all of this and no longer requires modern-lineage isolates to be called absent.
history.neutrality_proof: 11 of 15 finished samples keep their call (MTB3,9,14,18,21,22,24,28,29,30,31); MTB28 rebuilt differs only by the added explanatory paragraph and evidence row. history.data_refresh: stored tbd1 record regenerated for all finished samples from existing assemblies; originals kept.

history.change: v5 report layer. report.py: one gene-absence rule for all isolates (a gene is called absent only if the isolate has >=90% of its genome at >=10x, else 'not determined'; changes MTB4, MTB25, MTB32, MTB35 only); new section 17 'Cohort context' (cluster, closest isolates, closest public genome, mixed infection, IS6110, TbD1 variant) read from ref/cohort_context.json (built by code/c6_context.py from the cohort results); sections renumbered (Limitations 18, Methods 19); stale 'deferred to cohort round' statements updated; literal '%%' typos removed. check.py updated for the new section list.
